Main Function: The Lead Cybersecurity Engineer is a hybrid se curity role within the B usiness and Technology (Biz-Tech) team to defend the enterprise network and systems from digital attacks and to ensure protection of sensitive personal and corporate information in accordance with statutory requirements. The Lead Cybersecurity Engineer is a hands-on senior technical role overseeing cybersecurity and data and technology compliance . The role will ensure CBG policies are align ed with the Jamaica National Cybersecurity Standards Framework and ensure that the CBG remains aligned with cybersecurity and privacy risk compliance and management best practices. The role will identify and take corrective actions to fix flaws in the enterprise security profile (s ) , develop policy, and create procedures to improve the overall security and compliance of the CBG information and technology enterprise. This includes securing the online (cloud) presence as - well - as on premises infrastructure by filtering out suspicious activity; identifying and mitigating security risks to prevent breaches, loss, and misuse; ensuring appropriate tools are available to protect and remediate vulnerabilities and potential breaches; and implementing regulatory data protection compliance. The Lead Cybersecurity Engineer will primarily focus on: Identif ication and lead ing the efforts to counter security breaches and help reduce the likelihood of security incidents by taking a proactive stance on monitoring and alerting, then mitigation and/or remediation of threats. Define, plan, implement , maintain , and upgrade security and compliance policies, measures, and controls. Assist with the creation and implementation of a security awareness program (s) to raise the level of awareness and contribute positively towards threat prevention. Lead cybersecurity response by analyzing security and data breaches to identify causes and update inciden t response , disaster reco ve ry , and business continuity plans , and work with the CB Group Data Protection Officer (DPO) to identify breaches and manage response. Ensure end-user compliance with company security policies. Evaluate Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and ensure vulnerabilities are addressed based on severity across the enterprise. This includes regular review s of NIST databases . To evaluate emerging AI threats and develop a framework to provide a high level of assurance s and risk mitigating process as part of a continuous risk management. Remain current with emerging trends and best practices, ensuring proposed solutions align with group strategic goals and performanc e needs.
